facts.fact: In the 2022 US midterm elections, broadcast TV and cable TV/satellite accounted for approximately two-thirds of all political advertising spending.
facts.quote: broadcast TV and cable TV/satellite advertising accounted for approximately [two-thirds of all political advertising spending]

facts.fact: Per the article, 80% of US households now have at least one connected TV device.
facts.quote: with 80% of US households now having at least one connected TV device.

facts.fact: According to eMarketer as cited by StackAdapt, advertisers using both linear TV and CTV achieved a 32% increase in total reach compared to those using linear TV alone.
facts.quote: Advertisers leveraging both linear TV and CTV have achieved a 32% increase in total reach compared to those using linear TV alone.

facts.fact: Linear TV ads are bought in program slots based on the general viewer types a program attracts, while CTV targets individual households.
facts.quote: You buy ad spots during programs that generally attract certain types of viewers, but it’s a bit of a guess.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its Incremental Reach Measurement reports are delivered within 24 hours and updated daily.
facts.quote: You’ll get reports within 24 hours, updated daily, that show you metrics like the proportion of reach and unique reach.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says incremental reach forecasts are available instantly after a user searches their linear TV campaigns on its platform.
facts.quote: Search your linear TV campaigns on the platform, and you can generate incremental reach forecasts on the fly.
